Where did the frame_* photographs come from?

The frame_* names are the original filenames of an additional 320-image upstream collection, under grasp-vision / box_in_basket / white_box_pose. This viewer contains 12 selected originals from that collection. The earlier frozen collection contains 157 new_* and old_* photographs. The prefixes identify different collections; matching numbers do not establish a correspondence between photos.

Earlier R42 prediction comparisons

These preserved figures use the R42 reference labels and saved predictions. They are historical comparisons, not updated R43 scores. The latest row cards above show any newer corner or boundary amendment.

These are assistant-reviewed proposals. A held whole image stays outside the complete-candidate export, even when some of its rows have useful corrections. Soft contours support nominal coordinates. No human sign-off, new training result, or independent test performance is claimed.
